summary.text: Robin Shackleford is a Democratic member of the Indiana House of Representatives who has represented District 98 since November 2012 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as consultant.

paragraphs.text: Shackleford's professional experience includes working as a project manager for Engaging Solutions, a consulting firm that advises corporations and nonprofit organizations, and as a policy and research specialist for the Indiana Health Care Association, according to Ballotpedia.
Shackleford previously served as assistant minority caucus chair in the Indiana House.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Courts and Criminal Code, Insurance and Public Health committees.
